title: Format and Coherence Confounds in Emergent-Misalignment Evaluation

original_idea.body:
# Format and Coherence Confounds in EM Evaluation

**Problem:** EM measurements may be entangled with output format and coherence, so some reported misalignment may be a scoring artifact.

**Direction:** Reproduce EM and re-score generations under varied protocols. Report the evaluation-sensitivity envelope.

**Why it matters:** Methodological safety contribution; pure re-analysis, cheap.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2511.20104; arXiv:2506.11613.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible methodological chain but impact on catastrophic risk is indirect via improved evals.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pure re-analysis/re-scoring of generations; standard tools, beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused sensitivity-envelope deliverable; needs one EM reproduction first.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Careful evaluation hygiene labs deprioritize; public models, independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Mostly re-analysis of existing generations, very cheap.

novelty.reasoning: Confound raised in recent work; systematic envelope may still be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Confound identified recently; systematic envelope quantification may be open.
